'''Kauko Armas Nieminen''' (15 February 1929 – 2010) was a Finnish self-taught [[physicist]].<ref>{{cite web|title=KUVATAIDEAKATEMIAN GALLERIA|url=http://www2.kuva.fi/fi/nayttelyt/kalenteri/joonas-siren|publisher=Kuvataideakatemia|accessdate=23 March 2016|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403214659/http://www2.kuva.fi/fi/nayttelyt/kalenteri/joonas-siren|archivedate=3 April 2016}}</ref>

Nieminen was born in [[Kuopio]], [[Finland]]. Although he was most known for his work in physics, he had no academic training or degree in physics and was entirely self-taught. He had a bachelor's degree in law from the [[University of Helsinki]].

Nieminen's research and theories in physics were unusual. The basis of his work was the theory of "ether vortices". In principle, the theory claims that the universe is full of [[Luminiferous aether|ether]], and as the ends of the ether come close to each other, [[vortex|vortices]] appear. The center of a vortex is an [[elementary particle]]. Nieminen claimed his theories could explain [[gravity]], [[Quantum mechanics|quantum phenomena]], [[ball lightning]]s, and the creation of the world.<ref>Nieminen, Kauko: ''Eetteripyörteet voimina''. {{ISBN|951-99532-4-8}}.</ref>

Nieminen was also very critical towards the established scientific community, though not towards students of science, and had been frequently invited to lecture to the same amidst mutual respect and good humor.{{Citation needed|date=March 2008}}

Nieminen had published several books. Nieminen did not use a commercial publisher or advertisement agency; instead, he published and distributed his books and advertisements himself.

Kauko Nieminen was a deputy city council member of [[Helsinki]] from 2001 to 2004.<ref>[http://www.polyteekkari.fi/pt.pl?juttu=207 Polyteekkari 12/2002] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070928010216/http://www.polyteekkari.fi/pt.pl?juttu=207 |date=2007-09-28 }}</ref> In the 2000 municipal elections, he was a candidate from the joint election list of the independent candidates in the Helsinki Metropolitan area.<ref>[http://vaalit.om.fi/ehd_listat/helsinkihelsingfors.html Candidates in the municipal elections in 2000] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030053258/http://vaalit.om.fi/ehd_listat/helsinkihelsingfors.html |date=2008-10-30 }}</ref>
